root_cause_criterion.criterion: After `x509_get_subject_alt_name()` frees the tail sequence reachable from `subject_alt_name->next` on the fatal SAN error path, it must clear `subject_alt_name->next` before returning `ret`; otherwise later certificate cleanup reloads the freed tail pointer instead of NULL.
root_cause_criterion.description: The malformed-entry cleanup at `x509_get_subject_alt_name()` frees every tail node reachable from `subject_alt_name->next`, but the vulnerable return leaves that head field unchanged. The fixed program inserts `subject_alt_name->next = NULL;` before the same return, so the later certificate cleanup reloads NULL instead of the freed tail head.

nodes.state: `mbedtls_x509_crt_free()` reloads `seq_cur` from `cert_cur->subject_alt_names.next`, and on the crashing path that field still holds the dangling tail pointer left by the earlier SAN cleanup.
`mbedtls_x509_crt_free()` dereferences `seq_cur->next` while `seq_cur` still names the freed SubjectAltName tail node, producing the AddressSanitizer heap-use-after-free READ 8.

edges.relation: The tail pointer left in `subject_alt_name->next` after the fatal SAN cleanup is later reloaded as `seq_cur` when `mbedtls_x509_crt_free()` starts freeing `cert_cur->subject_alt_names`, so cleanup reuses the freed tail base instead of NULL.
The `seq_cur` value loaded from `cert_cur->subject_alt_names.next` reaches `seq_cur = seq_cur->next;` unchanged, carrying the dangling tail node directly into the crashing dereference.
